profile.headline: UI | Angular | React | Front-End Developer
profile.summary:
Programming has grown from a hobby to an obsession. As a Software developer, I’ve built and deployed numerous full stack applications both autonomously and in small, agile teams. Solutions to real world problems are things I keep in mind when creating a new application. I love to find creative and efficient solutions to complex problems. I thrive working in driven, transparent and collaborative teams. 

My career has given me an opportunity to work with talented people and some great clients. I look forward to what tomorrow will bring.

I'm experienced in the following technologies: PHP, Ionic, React, Angular, Node, MySQL and API Design

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Matthews, North Carolina, United States · Remote

positions.title: Front End-UI Developer
positions.description:
•	Working in Agile based development environment and participating in daily SCRUM stand-up meetings. 
•	Involved in requirement gathering, designing, development, UI code reviews, and maintenance. 
•	Worked on Angular 7 for the ongoing project.
•	Work closely with Business users and Programmers to meet project requirements, goals, and desired functionality.
•	Responsible to start the project from the scratch using React Js. Consume data using nSP.
•	Creating new functionality, features on the Service Request Portal for the Admin team.
•	Performing bug fixes and code review.
•	Refactored the search suggestions system with Redux Saga to reduce the redundant nSP calls.
•	Building stable and maintainable codebases using React.
•	Expertise in React JS framework to develop the SPA. 
•	Created Single page applications with React using Hooks. Used react - router for routing.
•	Experienced in React JS and working with React Flux architecture.
•	Added Redux to simplified components data and state.
•	Experience in using React JS components, Forms, Events, Keys, Router, plus Redux, Animations and Flux concept.
•	Maintained states in the stores and dispatched the actions using Redux.
•	Applied optimization techniques to reduce the load time and page size to enhance user experience.
•	Involved in solving the production issues.
•	Implemented CI/CD for vendor application using Jenkins.
•	Work with other programmers to ensure that the application is functional and visually appealing.
Environment: JavaScript, React.JS, Angular 7, NPM tools, RESTful WebServices, HTML5, CSS3, BOOTSTRAP, SASS, COMPASS, Junit, visual design, Redux, Sourcetree, nSP.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Implemented a professional and production quality module systems with NodeJS.
•	Used Node.js for managing JavaScript packages using the npm tool.
•	Developed certain features of the application functionality i.e. CRUD (Create, read, update, delete) features using NodeJS, Require.js and Responsive Design
•	Used existing company owned framework similar to AngularJS to develop rich application.
•	Developed User Interfaces using semantic HTML5, SASS, BOOTSTRAP.
•	Created cross-browser compatible and standards-compliant CSS-based page layouts.
•	Used CORE and HTML tag libraries for expressing Java Server Faces within a view template.
•	Created a UI, which involved in displaying the customer transaction and profile information.
•	Used Velocity variables while creating dynamic templates.
•	Used JQuery framework for UI centric AJAX behavior.
•	Used Marionette.js for Composite application architecture and Modularization options.
•	Involved in testing the UI developed performing unit testing.
•	Involved in Re-framing application’s JavaScript architecture using JQuery.
•	Worked on UX designs for mobile view and IPad view.
•	Used Redux, and React to build out a web app.
•	Solid understanding of React's Virtual Dom Algorithm, for React performance.
•	Performed repetitive tasks like minification, building, compiling, and unit testing using Grunt.
•	Deploy rapid A/B prototypes for user testing on optimal Tablet web application experience using Node.js, Express, Grunt, Backbone.js, Sass, Handlebars, Require.js.
•	Solid understanding of React's Virtual Dom Algorithm, for React performance optimization.
•	Built applications for scale using JavaScript, NodeJS, and React.JS.
•	Using React.js and HTML5 for SPA development.
•	Developer responsive interface using Bootstrap and used SASS for CSS.
•	Designed dynamic and multi-browser compatible pages using HTML, CSS, AngularJS and JavaScript.
•	Have worked on AWS to integrate the server side and client side code.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Created user interface and navigation structure.
•	Implemented page designs in standard-complaint dynamic HTML and CSS.
•	Developed the Front End User Interface using HTML, Javascript, jQuery and CSS.
•	Created interactive navigation lists using list elements in HTML.
•	Implemented client side validations in registration forms, login and logout forms using Java Script.
•	Worked extensively with the file management and image libraries.
•	Performed client-side validations using Javascript.
•	Fixed bugs and provided support services for the application.
•	Interacted with Javascript controllers (jQuery, AJAX, and JSON) to write/read data from back end systems.
•	Extensively used jQuery, JSON, AJAX and DOM scripting to create interactive web applications like message posting and auto complete form validations.
•	Worked with jQuery widgets to create more interactive web pages.
•	Responsible in code optimizing and test across browsers.
•	Followed Service Oriented Architecture(SOA) and integration planning.
•	Actively participated in meetings with clients to determine website goals and develop strategies.
•	UI development with technologies like Angular JS and jQuery.
•	Implemented Presentation layer using CSS framework, Angular JS, Wire-framing and HTML.
•	Used Angular JS framework for building web-apps. Extensively worked on RESTful web services.
